challenge.better_approach: Changing the gate's root for repo-root components would fix bin but leave _repo_of ambiguous for any caller; the inspector is where the ambiguity lives.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a directory holding cairn/ is a repo root; a live-shape census root never holds cairn/cairn.
challenge.prior_art: 5dc2364a8adb added _repo_of for /tmp fixtures; this covers the repo-root case it did not foresee.
challenge.real_collision: None: RULE 1 and 5dc2364a8adb both want the census root's own repo only.

answers.falsifier: Done when (1) with the census root at <tmp>/cairn holding a cairn/ package and a bin/ component, encapsulation_holds for row bin hands import_sieve.import_sites only <tmp>/cairn, and a breach-shaped .py under a sibling <tmp>/wt-x is not read; (2) a cross-device import planted in <tmp>/cairn/bin/ reds on row bin; (3) the live shape <tmp>/cairn/devices/a (census root <tmp>/cairn with no cairn/ child) still takes <tmp> as the repo and still reds a cross-device import on row devices/a.
answers.from_idea: none, because the defect is measured on the PROVED crossing of ticket 8c5fdb750b75
answers.how: inspector.py: _repo_of returns the census root itself when it holds a cairn/ directory (a repo root named cairn), else the parent when named cairn, else itself. encapsulation_holds computes here as comp_dir's path relative to repo_root and the census set as each row's dir relative to repo_root, so the live shape (cairn/devices/x) is unchanged. The proof lays <tmp>/cairn as a repo root holding a cairn/ package and bin/, with a stray breach-shaped worktree at <tmp>/wt-x, shaped like cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_a_census_root_outside_a_repo_reads_only_itself.py.
answers.traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation_holds is its physics) and Law 8 (a gate that cannot answer in time refuses a real crossing; a row keyed off its breaches is a hollow green).
answers.what: encapsulation_holds judges a component that sits at the repo root (bin) against that repo alone: _repo_of takes a census root that itself holds a cairn/ package as the repo, never its parent, and the row's own address is its path relative to that repo, so bin's breaches land on bin.

bullets.text: A gated crossing of bin swept all of ~/dev/src (85 worktrees) because the repo is named cairn; the inspector now reads only the repo.

title: encapsulation_holds judges a component that sits at the repo root (bin) against that repo alone: _repo_of takes a census
